title: 船舶艙室防火分區
summary: 以艙室網路圖追蹤熱、煙與穿艙介面，將分區概念與完整認證防火設計清楚區分。 在艙室分區與熱流數位室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
summaryEn: Trace heat, smoke and penetrations in a compartment graph while separating education from certified fire design. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Compartment-zoning and heat-flow digital studio. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 隔板導熱與熱橋：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Bulkhead conduction and thermal bridges: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 隔板導熱與熱橋 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Bulkhead conduction and thermal bridges and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 在「船舶艙室防火分區」的「隔板導熱與熱橋」中，平板穩態熱傳由導熱係數、面積、溫差和厚度控制。 本單元須將作用機制畫成有輸入、輸出與邊界的圖，並核對是否符合本課問題：以艙室網路圖追蹤熱、煙與穿艙介面，將分區概念與完整認證防火設計清楚區分。
steps.instructionEn: Within Ship compartment fire zoning, Bulkhead conduction and thermal bridges examines this mechanism: Steady slab conduction depends on conductivity, area, temperature difference and thickness. Draw inputs, outputs and boundaries, then relate it to the course question: Trace heat, smoke and penetrations in a compartment graph while separating education from certified fire design.
steps.observation: 本單元為獨立假想教學台架，不可將不同單元數值拼成真實船舶規格。輸入：k=0.03 W/(m·K)，A=10 m²，ΔT=180 K，L=0.2 m。關係式 Q=kAΔT/L；含單位換算算式 0.03*10*180/0.2 = 270 W。適用條件：只含一維導熱；接縫熱橋、輻射和相變另算。
steps.observationEn: This unit is an independent hypothetical teaching bench; values from different units must not be combined into vessel specifications. Inputs: k=0.03 W/(m·K), area 10 m², ΔT=180 K and thickness 0.2 m. Relation Q=kAΔT/L; expression including unit conversion 0.03*10*180/0.2 = 270 W. Applicability: One-dimensional conduction only; joints, radiation and phase change are separate.
steps.failure: 本單元先檢查以下替代原因：把面板導熱性能當整艙性能會漏掉熱橋。 比較它和輸入真正變動時會出現的觀察差別。
steps.failureEn: First examine this alternative cause: Equating panel performance to compartment performance omits thermal bridges. Compare its observable pattern with a genuine change in the input.
steps.check: 對「隔板導熱與熱橋」，建立熱阻圖，將接縫旁路列為平行路徑。 保存原始觀察和推導，不以師傅輔助完成標記代替證據。
steps.checkEn: For Bulkhead conduction and thermal bridges, Draw thermal resistances and treat joint bypasses as parallel paths. Retain raw observations and derivation; an assisted-completion marker does not replace evidence.
